_doc: Every surface an image is published to. scripts/brand_render.py reads it; edit it as text.
safe = [top, right, bottom, left] insets in px that the platform covers or crops. template = banner, post, icon or shot.
verified = the date the spec was checked against source; null means confirm before relying on it. params = defaults for icon presets.

sizes.label: Open Graph / link preview
sizes.notes: Keep it under 1 MB anyway for fast unfurls.

sizes.label: LinkedIn post, landscape
sizes.notes: Min width 200; narrower posts show as a thumbnail.

sizes.label: LinkedIn post, square
sizes.notes: Secondary source.

sizes.label: LinkedIn company cover
sizes.notes: LinkedIn lists 1512x256 as min and recommended (some summaries say 4200x700; check in the Page editor). Displays near 1128x191, trims edges, and the Page logo overlaps the lower left on desktop.

sizes.label: LinkedIn personal background
sizes.notes: Profile photo covers the lower left; keep content in the central 1260x300.

sizes.label: LinkedIn page logo
sizes.notes: Min 268x268. Transparent logos get a white background, so ship an opaque tile.

sizes.label: X post image
sizes.notes: No official spec found; 1600x900 is the common recommendation.

sizes.label: X header
sizes.notes: Secondary source. Avatar covers the lower left (about 220x220); mobile crops about 60px top and bottom.

sizes.label: X profile photo
sizes.notes: Shown as a circle. Secondary source.

sizes.label: YouTube channel banner
sizes.notes: Secondary figures. Min 2048x1152; only the centre 1546x423 shows on every device.

sizes.label: GitHub social preview
sizes.notes: PNG under 1 MB, 1280x640 recommended, 640x320 minimum.

sizes.label: Thin strip, 8:1
sizes.notes: Email headers, directory strips.

sizes.label: App icon, generic
sizes.notes: Square master; most stores downscale from 1024.

sizes.label: Slack app icon
sizes.notes: Square, 512 to 2000 px.

sizes.label: Slack Marketplace screenshot
sizes.notes: Show the app in the context of Slack. Short description: 10 words or fewer.

sizes.label: HubSpot app icon
sizes.notes: Fill the square (touch at least two edges), no text or wordmark, no extra whitespace.

sizes.label: Product Hunt thumbnail
sizes.notes: GIF allowed.

sizes.label: Product Hunt gallery
sizes.notes: At least two images.

sizes.label: Chrome Web Store icon
sizes.notes: 96x96 artwork plus 16 px transparent padding; the mark must read on light and dark.

sizes.label: Chrome Web Store small promo tile
sizes.notes: Required.

sizes.label: Chrome Web Store marquee
sizes.notes: Optional; used for featured placement.

sizes.label: Chrome Web Store screenshot
sizes.notes: Full bleed, square corners. 1 to 5.

sizes.label: Zapier app logo
sizes.notes: Transparent PNG, no text; a non-square mark sits centred.
